concerns.text: Task T012b (Fetch ALL PRs) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T012a (Repo list). The 'Dependencies & Execution Order' section correctly notes this, but the [P] tag on T012b is misleading and violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule if interpreted as parallel execution with T012a. Remove [P] from T012b.

Tasks T019b (Create Template), T019c (Ingest Annotations), and T019d (Handle Missing Data) are marked [P] (parallel-safe). However, T019c and T019d logically depend on the existence of the template created in T019b and the workflow defined there. They cannot run in parallel with T019b or each without a defined state. Remove [P] from T019c and T019d.

Task T023a (Descriptive Stats) depends on T014 (Excluded Repos list) and T018b (Processed Data). While T014 and T018b are in Phase 3, T023a is in Phase 4. The 'Dependencies' section lists this, but the [P] tag on T023a implies it can run in parallel with other Phase 4 tasks (like T024) without ensuring T014/T018b are complete. Ensure T023a is not marked [P] if it implies independence from Phase 3 completion.

Tasks T026a (Standard MWU) and T026b (Stratified MWU) are marked [P]. However, T026b (Stratified) requires specific covariates (`lines_changed`, `total_prs_by_author`) that must be present in the dataset produced by T018b/T023a. If T026b runs before T023a ensures these fields exist, it will fail. The [P] tag suggests they can run in parallel with T023a/T024, which is unsafe. Remove [P] from T026b.

Tasks T034b (Load Spot Check), T035 (Limitation Logic), and T036b (Render Report) are marked [P]. T035 depends on T034b's output. T036b depends on T035, T034, T029, and T033. These form a strict serial chain. Marking them [P] violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule and the 'independently-shippable unit' principle for the report generation phase. Remove [P] from T035 and T036b.

Task T006c (Integrate logging) is marked [P] but the description states it 'must be called by every API request function in code/fetch_data.py'. Since T012a/T012b (API calls) are in Phase 3, T006c must be completed before T012a/T012b. While T006c is in Phase 2, the [P] tag might imply it can be done in parallel with T007 (Backoff) or T004 (Schemas) without dependency on T005 (Validation utility). Ensure the dependency on T005 is clear, and consider removing [P] if T006c requires T005 to be fully implemented first.
